notes.title: Architect Life | Patch 2025-07-16
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/a95e9ef309e292586c07be147c80db52abd8a5df.jpg"]



Hi everyone,


New patch today! You’ll find the patch notes below, they focus on improving certain aspects of the game, particularly its stability.

Improvement of title stability, including fixes to the folllowing issues :       

Possible crashes during the tutorial

Possible crash when renaming a room on the Bellebreeze map 

Possible crash selecting a door in The New Mill map 

Possible crash when dividing a bathroom in two in The New Mill map 

Possible crashes when using the roof generation tool
 Improvement of criteria validation system



 Thank you again for your continued support, and please keep sharing your feedback with us on Discord or the Steam forums!

notes.title: Architect Life | Hotfix 2025-06-20
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/b13dced2b4a6bd2fb962a9631f349d12a04c63af.jpg"]

Hi everyone,


Thank you so much for your support and feedback during the launch of Architect Life!


We’re reading all your messages, and we noticed that some players experienced issues with the mouse when a controller was plugged into your PC. 


We’ve just released a small hotfix to address this:

Fixed a potential issue with the mouse pointer when a controller was connected (mouse not responding or pointer flickering). 


Thank you again for your continued support, and please keep sharing your feedback with us on Discord or the Steam forums!

notes.title: Architect Life Demo Patch 1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/e5f0401b5077eeae01a9761f2b5e1eebf6e93d99.jpg

Hello Architects!

Thank you for playing Architect Life and for all your valuable feedback on our Discord or on the Steam forums! 

In this update, we’ve addressed several community-reported issues, including a fix for the language selection bug and improvements to overall stability.

We've also implemented an initial solution for multiple crash reports. However, if you continue to experience any crashes, please let us know so we can investigate further!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37743713/09eb078acf6a9a61eb3c10feb4ff9538bbe87c12.png

Architect Life Demo - Patch 1

Improvements and Fixes:
Language Selection Bug  - Performing a clean install (deleting the Architect folder in AppData) should prevent the language prompt from appearing on the first boot in the demo version. However, after this initial setup, language changes and reboots should function correctly.
AZERTY Keyboard Issue - Due to limited reports, we are still investigating this issue further.
Stability improvements
We've implemented initial fixes for the following crashes. In our tests, these issues were not reproduced on our end anymore, but we are continuing to investigate. If you still encounter these crashes, please report them to us.

 Crash when moving a wall in the demo.
 Crash when placing a door on a wall while the building is surrounded by fences.
 Crash when separating a fenced area with a room inside.
 Crash after deleting a curved fence.
 Crash after placing fences around a specific house.
 Crash related to placing interior doors on partitions.
 Crash occurring while playing in Free Mode.
 Crash when using the "Move a Wall" feature.
 Crash related to the Wall Edit tool.


Thank you for your support and feedback!

- The Architect Life Team 🏡
